profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google - On Device AI | Ex-intern @ Meta, Google, Oracle, Intel
profile.summary:
Currently working as a software engineer, primarily on algorithm design and language models for wearables. I'm passionate about finding efficient and innovative solutions for impactful problems, and basketball.

I have mixed internship/project experience on AI agents, ML infrastructure automation, data pipelines, predictive modeling and data analysis. 

Graduated from Data Science and Mathematics at ITESM Guadalajara (go Algoritmia!) where I was also involved in competitive programming.
